title: Metropolis
tagline: Between the hands and the head, the heart must be the mediator.
synopsis: In a dazzling city divided between its planners above and workers below, Freder discovers the human cost of progress—and a voice calling for understanding.

title: The General
tagline: A locomotive, a daring chase, and a very determined engineer.
synopsis: When a beloved locomotive is stolen, engineer Johnnie Gray sets off on a breathless chase full of invention, precision, and wonderfully deadpan mishaps.

title: Sherlock Jr.
tagline: A projectionist dreams himself into the picture.
synopsis: A movie-loving projectionist, wrongly accused and sound asleep, steps into a film-within-a-film where reality changes with every cut.

title: Safety Last!
tagline: The clock is ticking—and the city is very, very tall.
synopsis: A young man in the big city tries to make good on a promise to his sweetheart, building toward one of silent comedy's most vertiginous set pieces.

title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
tagline: A shadowy fairground. A somnambulist. A story that tilts.
synopsis: In a town unsettled by strange crimes, a storyteller recalls the sinister Dr. Caligari and his sleepwalking companion Cesare amid painted streets and uneasy angles.

title: A Trip to the Moon
tagline: One enormous leap into the unknown.
synopsis: A band of astronomers builds a capsule, takes aim at the moon, and discovers a strange new world in this playful, imaginative voyage.
